fusions.name: Vixen's Shriek
fusions.desc: Looses a scream in a narrow cone 4 tiles long that deals 12 resonating damage, stuns everything in it for 1 second and leaves them [Muddled] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Heard Through Snow
fusions.desc: A diving bite on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 26 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and ignores its armour.

fusions.name: Silent Yip
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds and slips you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Dusk Ears
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
